name: dev-cursor-plugins
description: Reusable skills, rules and agents for Claude Code and Cursor.

plugins.name: base-dev-kit
plugins.description: Honesty and security rules always applied, plus on-demand skills for clean code, git workflow, and testing principles — applicable to any language or stack.

plugins.name: frontend-dev-kit
plugins.description: Rules, skills, and MCP servers for React + TypeScript + shadcn/ui + Tailwind CSS + react-query.

plugins.name: pptx-dev-kit
plugins.description: Create a 16:9 PowerPoint from a brief via a checked-in layout engine, or edit an existing .pptx in place via OOXML.

plugins.name: agent-dev-kit
plugins.description: TypeScript/Node AI agents and RAG: OpenAI SDK via OpenRouter, @openai/agents or LangGraph.js, hybrid retrieval, Vitest eval.

plugins.name: backend-dev-kit
plugins.description: Rules, skills, and agents for Node.js backends with Express 5, TypeScript, Drizzle ORM, Zod, and Vitest.

plugins.name: spec-dev-kit
plugins.description: Multi-agent pipeline that turns raw requirements in .spec/context/ into a validated, human-approved hybrid YAML+Markdown spec for html-generator-kit and feature-dev-kit.

plugins.name: html-generator-kit
plugins.description: Turns a validated spec-dev-kit spec into a clickable, CDN-free, Alpine.js multi-page HTML prototype with a modern design direction sourced from ui-ux-pro-max, headless-browser verified before the skill-owned review gate.

plugins.name: feature-dev-kit
plugins.description: Hub-and-spoke factory that builds one React FSD screen-task from a spec-dev-kit spec (and optional html prototype), with architecture-audit, quality gates, and a skill-owned human review. Never opens a PR.

plugins.name: frontend-orchestrator-kit
plugins.description: Frontend-only sequencer: spec-dev-kit to author a spec, html-generator-kit to prototype it, then feature-dev-kit to build every UI screen-task against a persisted checklist. Use /orchestrate-app for the full-stack dispatcher.

plugins.name: app-orchestrator-kit
plugins.description: Full-stack app dispatcher: analyzes an approved spec and optional HTML prototype, then runs backend-dev-kit, agent-dev-kit, and frontend-orchestrator-kit only when needed, against a persisted work-plan.
